about.title: Aficionados Wine & Spirits
about.paragraph1: Aficionados is a boutique importer and distributor of specialty wines, spirits, beer and non-alcoholic beverage brands serving the Puerto Rico market since 2011. Our philosophy is simple: seek out producers with authenticity, craftsmanship, and a compelling story, then connect them with customers who value quality and a differentiated value in a very crowded space. Aficionados is devoted to being Puerto Rico’s trusted destination for thoughtfully curated beverages, fostering a culture of exploration, appreciation, and memorable experiences.
about.paragraph2: The portfolio includes more than 700 labels sourced from respected wineries, distilleries, and beverage producers around the world. From acclaimed estates in Napa, Bordeaux, and Tuscany to emerging producers, organic vineyards, artisanal spirits, and innovative craft projects, each selection is chosen for its character, quality, and sense of place. The highest aspiration is to enrich experiences and create lasting connections between producers, customers and consumers.

principles.title: Values
principles.body:
These principles guide every relationship we build.
Greatness — Excellence is a standard, never a destination.
Collaboration — Great partnerships create lasting value.
Accountability — Ownership defines our work and our reputation.
Simplicity — More is said and done with less.
Passion — Vivid fans of what we do and the brands we represent.
Devotion — Committed to new and better experiences.
Integrity — Real, honest, open, always do the right thing.

tasting.title: Experience our Tasting Room!
tasting.body: Located in Guaynabo, the tasting room is a place for exploration, conversation, and discovery. Whether attending a private event, sampling a new producer, or deepening your appreciation for wine and spirits, guests are welcomed by a knowledgeable team dedicated to making every visit engaging and memorable. Open from Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
